The test image shows a mango leaf with scattered dark black/dark gray spots and patches across the surface. The spots appear sooty, irregular, and superficial — not sunken lesions or powdery coating. The overall leaf color is greenish-yellow with these dark deposits distributed across the surface.

Key observations:
- Dark, sooty-looking black patches/spots scattered across the leaf
- Spots appear superficial, not necrotic lesions
- No white powdery coating (rules out Powdery_Mildew)
- No tip/margin browning necrosis (rules out Die_Back)
- Pattern looks like fungal growth on leaf surface rather than tissue lesions

This strongly suggests Sooty_Mould. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The Sooty_Mould reference image is a near-perfect match: same dark black/gray sooty patches scattered across a green-yellow mango leaf, same superficial fungal appearance, same distribution pattern. The test image and this reference are visually identical in disease presentation.
